tips.text: If The War Within drops you back at the mountain pass, kill the client completely, restart at the quest's opening and redo it; picking different dialogue options helped once.
Do not replay the quest for a spare; Operator abilities, Tauron Strikes and Tekolyst mods are disabled on a replay.
Rank the Scepter to 30 for its Mastery.
Expect to own it already: nobody complains about acquiring it, and the buggy quest ending is the only sore spot.
